instruction:
Task: identify the emotion that the target speaker expresses in the last utterance of this conversation from a TV show. Answer with one of: neutral, surprise, fear, sadness, joy, disgust, anger.

Conversation:
fusion: score = (1 - w) log p_ECERC + w log p_LLM
selection: highest mean dev macro-F1 over pairs; ties to the smaller w

criteria.primary: mean over (ECERC checkpoint x expert seed) pairs of test macro-F1(fused) - macro-F1(ECERC alone)
success: mean F1 change > 0 for Fear and for Disgust
delta > 0 in at least 70% of pairs

multiplicity: test look 3 of 3; Bonferroni-adjusted 98.33% CI also reported
